chunks: And the Commander of the Faithful, peace be upon him, said:
"Engage in trade—may Allah bless you—for I heard the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, say: 'Provision is ten parts: nine are in trade, and one is in other than it.'"

key_terms.الرِّزْقَ: Provision or sustenance granted by Allah
key_terms.بَارَكَ اللَّهُ لَكُمْ: May Allah grant blessing to you

ai.seo_question: What does the hadith say about trade and where most provision is found?
ai.summary: Amir al-Mu'minin عليه السلام encourages people to engage in trade and cites a saying of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم about the abundance of rizq found in commerce. The hadith highlights trade as a prominent means of lawful livelihood and presents it as a blessed avenue for seeking sustenance.
